title: Drum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- top drum head (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='32' ry='13' fill='#F2C46A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='24' ry='9' fill='#FBE3A8'/>
  <!-- drum body -->
  <path d='M18 32 L18 68 A32 13 0 0 0 82 68 L82 32 A32 13 0 0 1 18 32 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- bottom rim band -->
  <path d='M18 60 L18 68 A32 13 0 0 0 82 68 L82 60 A32 13 0 0 1 18 60 Z' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <!-- zig-zag lacing (bright) -->
  <g stroke='#FBE3A8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <path d='M20 44 L30 52 L40 44 L50 52 L60 44 L70 52 L80 44'/>
    <path d='M20 56 L30 48 L40 56 L50 48 L60 56 L70 48 L80 56'/>
  </g>
  <!-- smiley face on body: eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FBE3A8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FBE3A8'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 54 Q50 64 60 54' stroke='#FBE3A8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sticks -->
  <line x1='30' y1='10' x2='20' y2='58' stroke='#E8B24C' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='10' x2='80' y2='58' stroke='#E8B24C' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='10' r='4' fill='#FBE3A8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='10' r='4' fill='#FBE3A8'/>
</svg>
